title: Entanglement Entropy and Complexity of Multicomponent Universe from Holography
summary: Recent studies in \cite{Park:2020jio,Paul:2025gpk} have calculated various holographic information-theoretic quantities of the four-dimensional FLRW universe for different matter-dominated eras using the braneworld model of cosmology. These studies are done for a single matter component, which is a good toy model for understanding the entanglement properties of the universe. However, for a more realistic model, one should consider a scenario where our universe has coexisting matter components like radiation-dark matter or radiation-exotic matter, etc. In this work, we have presented a…
